Q9008.reason: FRE 607 lets the calling party impeach its own witness with a prior inconsistent statement, including earlier grand-jury testimony that now contradicts the trial testimony.

Q9010.reason: Statutes are a legislature's written rules organized into a systematic code, so they are called codified law.

Q9011.reason: Attempt and intent-to-injure assault require specific intent he denied having, while battery is complete on a reckless application of force that actually struck the pedestrian.
